About

Client trust, built on precision.

My path into account management started in an unexpected place: ten years of medical training that sharpened how I listen, diagnose a problem, and explain a plan clearly to someone who's relying on me to get it right. Those are the same instincts I bring to a client relationship.

As an Account Manager & PR intern at Brand Aid Marketing Solutions, I sat in client briefings, translated those conversations into concepts, and helped shape them into the proposals and decks that got signed off. I coordinated with internal teams to keep timelines on track, flagged issues before they became problems, and kept clients in the loop with the kind of steady communication that builds long-term trust.

I've since paired that experience with a Sales & Marketing Diploma from AUC, and I'm looking to bring both client-facing polish and genuine attention to detail to an account management team full-time.

Selected Work

Three client briefs, three worlds.

Built during my time on the account team at Brand Aid Marketing Solutions, where I supported concept development and client-facing proposal decks for L'Oréal Paris and Nutridar activations. Each one called for a completely different brand language, which is exactly the part of this work I like most.

No. 01

Elvive Collagen Lifter

L'Oréal Paris
Product Launch Event
Brand
L'Oréal Paris
Format
Immersive launch activation, "science lab" concept
My role
Concept support & client proposal deck, Brand Aid Marketing Solutions

The brief: launch Elvive Collagen Lifter as more than a product drop. It needed to feel like an unveiling. We built the night around L'Oréal's research process itself, walking guests through a "Science Lab" journey from QR check-in to a DNA Hair Lift Chamber, a Hair Analysis Lab, and a Formula Lab, before landing at a sushi bar and cocktail stage for the reveal.

Every touchpoint reinforced one idea: the same volume as a salon blowout, engineered at home. Photo moments, styling stations, and a full gifting suite gave guests a reason to leave talking about it.

Guest journey design Mood board & venue selection Activation concepts Gifting & sampling

No. 02

Nutridar

Nutrition for Life
Booth & Brand Experience
Brand
Nutridar
Format
Exhibition booth, mood board & engagement proposal
My role
Concept support & client proposal deck, Brand Aid Marketing Solutions

Nutridar needed a booth that felt like the brand's promise made physical: nutrition as an act of love, not just a category claim. We designed a soft palette of blue, white and beige, rounded forms and cloud motifs, to evoke calm and protection from the moment a mother steps in.

Engagement was built around real, gentle interaction rather than noise: an iPad nutrition quiz that ends in a personalized plan, an instant-polaroid "Sahha Moments" memory corner, a baby sensory wall, and an aromatherapy relaxation nook for parents. The takeaway PR box carried the same calm identity home.

Booth concept & mood board Interactive engagement design PR box & gifting

No. 03

Women of Worth

L'Oréal Paris
Recognition Gala
Brand
L'Oréal Paris
Format
Black-and-gold gala honoring women in advocacy, business & sport
My role
Concept support & client proposal deck, Brand Aid Marketing Solutions

Women of Worth is L'Oréal Paris' tribute to women reshaping their communities. This proposal set the evening at Roi Des Pins, Beirut, with an Oscars-style black-and-gold arrival built for exactly that gravity, a candlelit walkway, a stage framed for real recognition, and a scripted flow from QR-coded entrance to gala dinner.

Invitations went out over WhatsApp with a built-in RSVP poll, entry secured with a one-time QR code, small logistics that shaped a smoother, more premium guest experience before anyone arrived. Every detail after that, uniforms, tablescapes, the "WOW" marquee photo moment, was built to match the honorees being celebrated.

Full event concept Guest flow & RSVP logistics Recognition ceremony design Influencer & MC sourcing
